column1: # Functional categories of plastid genes for PlastomeExport.jl gene-table.
# match: exact (gene name), kind (tRNA or rRNA), prefix (longest matching prefix wins).
# Lookup order: exact, kind, prefix. Genes matching nothing go to "Unclassified" with a warning.
# The order of rows sets the order of categories and subgroups in the output tables.
# color: fill of the subgroup on genome maps (PlastomeExport.jl map); one color per subgroup.
